rule: A compact GCL-04 record plus this explicit profile materializes one full GCL-01 encounter-template record. Profile values are attributable inherited data, never silent defaults, and never create a Campaign-local Encounter.

nonauthorization: not an Encounter draft or snapshot
not Scene attachment or live state
not a required player choice or resolved outcome

compatibility_projection.required_object_categories: derived only from slot_ids later bound by an authorized F012 consumer

constraints.statement: Materializing an encounter archetype does not create a real Encounter; F012-owned composition, validation and human approval are required.
Pressure dimensions are structural references only and may not be collapsed into a universal score or guarantee.
Participant, hazard, scale and boss/solo mechanics must come from governed sources; the archetype cannot invent missing mechanics.

compatibility_projection.unknowns: all Campaign-specific participants, quantities, waves, objectives, source mechanics, rules context, scale interactions, visibility and outcomes remain explicit unknowns until an owning consumer supplies them

known_unknowns: real participants, objectives, governing mechanics, scale and campaign context are intentionally absent

slot_shape.cardinality: zero_or_one unless a later version explicitly marks otherwise
slot_shape.unresolved_reason: GCL-04 encounter archetypes intentionally leave Campaign/world-specific bindings, mechanics and live state open.

slot_materialization.ai_rule: AI may propose bindings only from the initiating subject's authorized projection; no proposed binding becomes Encounter/Campaign/Scene truth without explicit owning-domain action.

pressure_dimension_semantics: pressure_dimensions are PPIA-11/F012 dimension labels describing what the encounter shape may expose. They are not difficulty magnitudes, weights, targets or tuning instructions.

notes: Ready-to-use means GM-usable encounter construction material after contextual binding, not an approved or analyzed Encounter.
Participants, objectives, pressure references, exits and alternative approaches remain replaceable/remixable.

forbidden_materialization_behavior: silently choosing values for unbound slots
creating or approving a Campaign-local Encounter or placement
creating a Scene attachment, launch state, live Session/combat state or Event
collapsing pressure dimensions into a universal Challenge Rating, encounter level, threat score, power scalar or guaranteed balance label
turning objective prompts into live objective truth
converting possible exit vectors into resolved outcomes
inventing participant, hazard, mixed-scale or boss/solo mechanics not present in governed sources
treating boss_solo structure as adversary transformation authority
dropping provenance, uncertainty or authority labels
